description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.100.7 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Run StepCode as a Step Plan transport (#7267)
- Drop Start at Login from the desktop Getting started and let Home hide it (#9007)
- Switch models on/off from Providers and an Overall tab in Models (#9008)
Bug Fixes
- Collapse account pool settings to title and switch; stack quota rows again (#9004)
- Preserve split CRLF through the empty-tool guard (#8968)
- Refund unused sidecar hop when account rotation throws (#8899)
- Catalog Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Carbon (#8932)
- Nest tool-result images for Gemini 3+ and catalog gemini-4-neon (#8970)
- Isolate thrown vendor quota probe errors in /api/provider-quotas (#8948)
- Avoid repeated disabled model scans at launch (#8946)
- Reuse provider policy across static model rows (#8952)
- Recover daily-limit and CN 403 pricing-URL quota errors (#8964)
- Offer native Ultrafast for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (#8995)
- Promote retained GPT-6.2 fallbacks written from an older Sol template (carry of #8891) (#9010)
- Expose discovered Antigravity models and native log traces (#8957)
- A main-account 429 in the Codex pool no longer parks the whole target (#8880) (#9011)
- Keep System One decision models off chat surfaces (#8997) (#9009)
- Escape over a page dialog closes only that dialog, not Add Provider (#8849) (#9012)
- Read the web-session account from the chat HTML when hydration data is gone (#8994)
- Remote Link Child auth, Child status page and Windows probe (#8972, #8999, #8985) (#9018)
Chores
- Cover the snapshot refresh-read owner cutoff (#8967)
- An Overall switch survives a poll read during its write (#9014)
